reason: The measurements check out exactly - I reproduced every number by driving master.html. On open at owner-flight the rail panel sits at top 597 / bottom 1156 (559px) inside a 925px .b-stick, [data-act=done] at 1036-1075 and [data-act=delete] at 1100-1139 at EVERY desk width, giving 31% visible at 1024x768, 36% at 1152x800 and 1280x800, 54% at 1440x900, 65% at 1440x960; at 1024x768 the title input (708-749) is the last thing fully on screen and the WHEN field (783-823) and steppers (829-869) are below the fold. keepInBand does return early on the rail. So the observation is accurate. The finding dies on its fix, which is the exact assumption round 7 refuted. .b-editHost lives inside .b-stick, which is position:sticky, top:40px at >=1024, so the panel does NOT move 1:1 with the page: it pins after 191px of travel and stays pinned until the containing block runs out at the very bottom of the document. I applied the proposed patch verbatim. At every width it scrolls the computed delta (412px at 1024x768, 380 at 1280x800, 280 at 1440x900, 220 at 1440x960) and the panel lands in the IDENTICAL place every time - top 406, bottom 965 - because the sticky pin, not the scroll, decides. Result: at 1024x768 Done is still at 845-884, 116px below a 768 fold, and Delete at 909-948 is 181px below it; at 1152x800 and 1280x800 Done is still 45px below the fold; only at 1440x900 does Done squeak on (884 of 900, Delete still off) and at 1440x960 Done and Delete arrive but the panel foot at 965 is still cut. So the patch throws the owner's place 412px down the plan and delivers nothing for the primary action at precisely the three widths where the defect is worst - same defect, plus a lost reading position, which is worse than leaving it alone. Worse still, the finding's own proposed gate line, 'the [data-act=done] rect is wholly inside the viewport', would FAIL at 1024x768, 1152x800 and 1280x800 with its own fix installed: it ships an assertion its remedy cannot pass. The finding quotes round 7's refutation but answers only the repeat-press half of it and never the half that kills it - the rail does not hold still under scroll. Two mitigations also soften the problem it names: this is a normal in-flow rail panel on a 2130px document with an ordinary scrollbar, not a trapping overlay, and I tabbed the whole editor at 1024x768 - every field, stepper, Done and Delete is reached and brought into view by focus. REFUTED on the fix.
sharpenedFix: If a later round wants this, it must be a layout change, not a scroll - scrolling cannot work while the panel is inside a sticky rail. The panel is 559px sitting under a ~366px horizon/counter block in the same 925px column. When data-editor-open is set, collapse or drop the horizon block in the rail (or move .b-editHost above it) so the panel starts near the rail's top and the whole 559px falls inside even a 768px viewport with no page movement at all; capping the panel's own height with an internal scroll is the second-best option and would seat Delete under a scrollable region, so prefer the reordering. Whichever is chosen, extend the gate's open-state loop to 1024x768, 1152x800 and 1440x960 and assert the [data-act=done] rect is wholly inside the viewport - that assertion is right; only the remedy proposed here is wrong.
